subject: maths
title: Chapter 3 · Test 3
summary: Chapter 3 test 3: indices, scientific notation, exponential growth and decay, compound interest, logarithms and exponential equations.
body:
Chapter 3 · Test 3 covers the whole chapter: negative and fractional indices, scientific notation and significant figures, exponential growth and decay, compound interest, logarithms, and solving exponential equations.

Allow **about 25 minutes**. Work with **no notes**, and **no calculator unless the question says** you may use one. There are 15 questions: 4 easy, 5 medium, 4 hard and 2 challenge. Write your working on paper so you can check which step went wrong if you miss one. When you finish, go back to the lesson for any topic you found tricky, then try another test in this chapter.

questions.explanation: An index of ½ means square root: √36 = 6. Halving 36 to get 18 is the common slip.
steps: An index of ½ means the square root: 36^(1/2) = √36.

mistakes.A: Step 1: an index of ½ is not "multiply by ½" — it is a square root.
mistakes.C: Step 1: only a negative index flips the number. This index is positive.
mistakes.D: Step 1: 1296 is 36², squaring instead of square-rooting.

questions.explanation: A power of 5 means move the point 5 places right: 4.05 → 405 000.
steps: The power is positive, so the number is big — move the point right.

mistakes.A: Step 2: that moves the point only 4 places. Count 5 moves.
mistakes.B: Step 2: that moves the point 6 places. Count exactly 5 moves.
mistakes.C: Step 1: a positive power makes the number bigger, so move the point right.

questions.prompt: A bank account pays interest "compounded quarterly". What does this mean?

options.A: Interest is added 4 times a year
options.B: Interest is added once every 4 years
options.C: Interest is added 3 times a year

questions.explanation: A quarter is 3 months, so compounding quarterly adds interest 4 times a year (every 3 months).
steps: A quarter of a year is 3 months.
12 ÷ 3 = 4, so interest is added 4 times a year.

mistakes.B: Step 1: a quarter is a quarter of a YEAR, not 4 years.
mistakes.C: Step 2: every 3 months gives 12 ÷ 3 = 4 times a year, not 3.
mistakes.D: Step 1: "quarterly" describes how often interest is added, not the rate.

mistakes.A: Step 2: 5² = 25, not 1/25. One over needs a negative index.
mistakes.B: Step 2: 5^(1/2) = √5, not 1/25. A fractional index is a root.
mistakes.D: Step 2: 5^(−1/2) = 1/√5. You need 1/5², so the index is −2.

questions.explanation: Flip: (81/16)^(1/4). Fourth roots: ⁴√81 = 3 and ⁴√16 = 2, so 3/2.
steps: The minus sign flips the fraction: (81/16)^(1/4).
The 4 means fourth root of top and bottom: ⁴√81 = 3, ⁴√16 = 2.

mistakes.A: Step 1: you took the fourth root but forgot to flip for the negative index.
mistakes.C: Step 1: a negative index flips the fraction; it does not make it negative.
mistakes.D: Step 2: you flipped but did not take the fourth root.

questions.explanation: The first three significant figures are 4, 9, 9; the next digit is 6, so round up: 0.00499 → 0.00500. The zeros must be kept to show 3 s.f.
steps: Start at the first non-zero digit: 4, 9, 9 are the first three significant figures.
The next digit is 6, so round up: 499 becomes 500.
Keep the zeros to show 3 s.f.: 0.00500.

mistakes.A: Step 3: 0.005 has only 1 significant figure. Keep the trailing zeros: 0.00500.
mistakes.B: Step 2: the next digit is 6, so you must round up, not chop.

questions.prompt: A table of values shows x = 0, 1, 2, 3 and y = 2, 6, 18, 54. Which rule fits?
questions.explanation: Each y is 3 times the one before, and y = 2 when x = 0, so y = 2 × 3ˣ. Check: 2 × 3³ = 54 ✓
steps: k is the y value at x = 0: k = 2.

mistakes.A: Step 2: the differences are 4, 12, 36 — not constant, so it is not linear.
mistakes.C: Step 2: you swapped k and a. k = 2 is the start; a = 3 is the ratio.
mistakes.D: Step 1: 6 is the y value at x = 1. k is the value at x = 0.

questions.explanation: 10 000 = 10⁴, so log₁₀ 10 000 = 4. Counting all 5 digits gives 5, which is one too many.
steps: Write 10 000 as a power of 10: 10 000 = 10⁴ (four zeros).

mistakes.A: Step 1: a log is not a division by 10. Find the power of 10.
mistakes.B: Step 1: 10 000 has 5 digits but only 4 zeros: 10⁴.

mistakes.A: Step 3: to undo − 2, add 2 to both sides, not subtract.
mistakes.B: Step 3: 4 is the value of x − 2. Add 2 to find x.
mistakes.D: Step 1: write 81 as a power of 3 first — the index x − 2 is not equal to 81.

questions.prompt: An investment of $6250 grows to $7290 in 2 years, with interest compounded annually. What is the interest rate? (You may use a calculator.)

mistakes.B: Step 1: that shares $1040 equally over 2 years (simple interest). Solve (1 + r)² = 1.1664.
mistakes.C: Step 2: 1.1664 is the growth over 2 years. Take the square root for one year.
mistakes.D: Step 3: 1.08 is the multiplier. Subtract 1, then write it as a percentage.

steps: Multiply by x⁻¹: add the indices: 3/2 + (−1) = 1/2.

mistakes.B: Step 2: the index on x is −1, so add −1, not +1.
mistakes.C: Step 1: the power 3 applies to the 2 as well.

questions.prompt: The graph has the rule y = k × aˣ and passes through the marked points (0, 80) and (1, 60). Find y when x = 3.
questions.diagram_alt: A decreasing exponential curve for x from 0 to 2, passing through the marked points (0, 80) and (1, 60).
steps: k is the value at x = 0: k = 80.

mistakes.A: Step 2: it does not fall by 20 each time — exponential rules multiply by the same number.
mistakes.B: Step 3: that is x = 2 (0.75²). Use x = 3.
mistakes.C: Step 2: divide the later value by the earlier one: 60 ÷ 80, not 80 ÷ 60.

questions.explanation: 3 log₂ 4 = log₂ 4³ = log₂ 64. Then log₂ 64 − log₂ 8 = log₂ 8 = 3. (Or: 3 × 2 − 3 = 3.)

mistakes.A: Step 1: the 3 multiplies log₂ 4 — you left it out (2 − 3).
mistakes.C: Step 1: 3 log₂ 4 is log₂ 4³ = log₂ 64, not log₂ (3 × 4).
mistakes.D: Step 2: the two logs are subtracted, not added (6 + 3).

questions.prompt: Mars is about 2.25 × 10¹¹ m from Earth. Light travels at 3 × 10⁸ m/s. How many minutes does a radio signal take to reach Mars?

mistakes.A: Step 3: 750 is in seconds. Divide by 60 to get minutes.
mistakes.C: Step 3: to change seconds to minutes, divide by 60 — don't multiply.
mistakes.D: Step 2: 11 − 8 = 3, so the answer is 0.75 × 10³ s = 750 s, not 75 s.

questions.prompt: $12 000 is invested at 5.4% p.a. compounded monthly. After how many whole months is it first worth more than $15 000? (You may use a calculator.)
questions.explanation: r = 0.054 ÷ 12 = 0.0045, so 1.0045ⁿ > 1.25 and n > log 1.25 ÷ log 1.0045 = 49.7. Round up: 50 months. (After 49 months it is only $14 953.00.)

mistakes.A: Step 3: after 49 months it is $14 953.00 — not yet over $15 000. Round up.
mistakes.B: Step 2: that adds $54 every month (simple interest). Compound interest grows faster.
mistakes.D: Step 2: that is about the number of years. The question asks for months, and n counts months here.
